title: Determination of bisphenols A and F in wastewater by coacervative extraction and LC-fluorimetry
author: Ballesteros-Gómez, Ana
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Prepare decanoic acid coacervate
steps.instruction: Mix decanoic acid with tetrahydrofuran (THF) to form reverse‑micelle coacervates; the exact amounts are chosen to obtain the desired concentration factor (the method works independent of salt up to 1 M, temperature up to 60 °C and pH < 4).

steps.title: Add water sample to coacervate
steps.instruction: Pipette 10.8 mL of the wastewater or river‑water sample into the prepared coacervate and vortex/mix for 5 minutes to allow analyte partitioning.

steps.title: Centrifuge to separate phases
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture for 10 minutes (speed not specified) to accelerate phase separation and collect the coacervate (extract) phase.

steps.title: Analyze by LC‑fluorimetry
steps.instruction: Inject the collected coacervate directly into the liquid‑chromatography system equipped with a fluorimetric detector; no clean‑up or solvent‑evaporation steps are required.
